name: Cuisses
shortDescription: Leather and metal cuisses based on a Prince Armory design, modified to connect with matching greaves below the knee.
description: These cuisses use a pattern and design by Prince Armory and were built to work together with my greaves. I modified the upper portion so it can be removed, allowing the cuisses to connect just below the knee.

A metal flail runs from the knee upward and around the side of the leg, while the remainder of the construction is leather. The changes make the piece part of a larger modular leg-armor setup rather than a completely independent piece.

details.Metal Coverage: From knee upward and around side of leg
